language_specific.morphology: 보- + -고 싶어요 gives 보고 싶어요; -고 싶다 expresses the speaker's wish.

language_specific.morphology: 듣- + -고 싶어요 gives 듣고 싶어요; -고 싶다 expresses the speaker's wish.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 밖에 나가다: go outside.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 가요, the polite present form of 가다; 내일 gives the sentence future time.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회사에 가다: go to work.

language_specific.morphology: The ㅂ-irregular stem 춥- changes to 추우- before -어요, giving 추워요; 안 precedes 추워요 to negate the state.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 일 안 하다: not work.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 서요, the polite present form of 서다, to negate the action.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 역에 서다: stop at a station.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 넣었어요, the polite past form of 넣다, to negate the action.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 설탕을 넣다: add sugar.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 안 넣었어요 [안 너어써요]. The ㅎ in 넣- is not pronounced before the vowel-initial ending.

language_specific.morphology: 보- + -아요 contracts to 봐요; 안 precedes 봐요 to negate the action.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 영화를 보다: watch a film.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 잘 거예요, formed from 자- + -ㄹ 거예요, to express an intention not to sleep early.
안 precedes 좋아해요, the informal polite form of 좋아하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 김치를 안 좋아하다: not like kimchi.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 타요, the informal polite form of 타다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 택시를 안 타다: not take a taxi.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 믿어요, the informal polite form of 믿다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 안 믿다: not believe what someone says.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 잡았어요: 잡- + -았어요, the past informal polite form of 잡다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 약속을 안 잡다: not arrange an appointment.

language_specific.morphology: 안 precedes 비싸요, the informal polite form of 비싸다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 별로 안 비싸다: not very expensive.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 해요, the informal polite form of 하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 못 하다: be unable to speak.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 나가요, the informal polite form of 나가다.
못 precedes 잤어요: 자- + -았어요 contracts to 잤어요.
못 precedes 읽어요, the informal polite form of 읽다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 못 읽어요 [모딜거요/몬닐거요]. The word boundary allows more than one realization.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 써요: 쓰- + -어요 becomes 써요.
못 precedes 탔어요: 타- + -았어요 contracts to 탔어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 버스를 못 타다: be unable to catch a bus.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 샀어요: 사- + -았어요 contracts to 샀어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 표를 못 사다: be unable to buy a ticket.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 들어가요, the informal polite form of 들어가다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 안에 못 들어가다: be unable to go inside.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 들었어요: the ㄷ in 듣- changes to ㄹ before -었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 잘 못 듣다: be unable to hear well.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 했어요: 하- + -였어요 contracts to 했어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 전화를 못 하다: be unable to make a phone call.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 먹었어요: 먹- + -었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 점심을 못 먹다: be unable to eat lunch.

common.sentence: 눈이 많이 와요. 차가 못 가요.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 가요, the informal polite form of 가다.
못 precedes 들어요: 들- + -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 혼자 못 들다: be unable to lift something alone.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 갔어요: 가- + -았어요 contracts to 갔어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 집에 못 가다: be unable to get home.

common.sentence: 컴퓨터가 고장 났어요. 일을 못 해요.

language_specific.morphology: 못 precedes 해요, the informal polite form of 하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 일을 못 하다: be unable to work.

language_specific.morphology: 열- + -어 links 열다 to 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 창문을 열어 주다: open a window for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 닫- + -아 links 닫다 to 주세요, the polite request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 창문을 닫아 주다: close a window for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 기다리- + -어 contracts to 기다려 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 여기서 기다려 주다: wait here for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 말씀하- + -여 contracts to 말씀해 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker respectfully asks the addressee to speak slowly.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 천천히 말씀해 주다: speak slowly for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 말하- + -여 contracts to 말해 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 한 번 더 말해 주다: say something once more for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 찍- + -어 links 찍다 to 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사진을 찍어 주다: take a photo for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 놓- + -아 links 놓다 to 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 짐을 방에 놓아 주다: put luggage in the room for someone.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 놓아 주세요 [노아 주세요]; ㅎ is not pronounced between the vowels.

language_specific.morphology: 줄이- + -어 contracts to 줄여 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 셔츠를 줄여 주다: make a shirt smaller for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 고치- + -어 contracts to 고쳐 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시계를 고쳐 주다: repair a watch for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 틀- + -어 links 틀다 to 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 노래를 틀어 주다: play a song for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 가져다주- + -세요 forms 가져다주세요, a polite request from 가져다주다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the addressee to bring water to the child, the beneficiary.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아이에게 물을 가져다주다: bring water to a child.

common.sentence: 제 동생에게 이 책을 전해 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 전하- + -여 contracts to 전해 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks the addressee to pass the book to the speaker's younger sibling.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 동생에게 책을 전해 주다: pass a book on to a younger sibling.

language_specific.morphology: 복사하- + -여 contracts to 복사해; 복사해 주세요 uses the -아/어 주다 request pattern.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문서를 복사하다: copy a document.

common.sentence: 이 신발을 다른 크기로 바꿔 주세요.

language_specific.morphology: 바꾸- + -어 contracts to 바꿔 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 신발을 다른 크기로 바꿔 주다: exchange shoes for another size.

language_specific.morphology: 부르- + -어 becomes 불러 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이름을 불러 주다: call someone's name.

language_specific.morphology: 전화하- + -여 contracts to 전화해 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 번호로 전화해 주다: call a number for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 알리- + -어 contracts to 알려 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 뜻을 알려 주다: tell someone the meaning.

language_specific.morphology: 보내- + -어 contracts to 보내 before 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 짐을 집에 보내 주다: send luggage home for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 접- + -어 links 접다 to 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 종이를 반으로 접어 주다: fold paper in half for someone.

language_specific.morphology: 넣- + -어 links 넣다 to 주세요, the request form of 주다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 국에 소금을 넣어 주다: add salt to soup for someone.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 넣어 주세요 [너어 주세요]; ㅎ is not pronounced between the vowels.

language_specific.morphology: 앉- + -으세요 → 앉으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '앉으세요' [안즈세요]. In the final cluster ㄵ, ㄴ remains and ㅈ moves to the following vowel.

language_specific.morphology: 닫- + -으세요 → 닫으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문을 닫다: close the door.

language_specific.morphology: 오- + -세요 → 오세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이쪽으로 오다: come this way.

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -세요 → 가세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
기다리- + -세요 → 기다리세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
쓰- + -세요 → 쓰세요; the stem vowel remains before -세요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이름을 쓰다: write a name.

language_specific.morphology: 읽- + -으세요 → 읽으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '읽으세요' [일그세요]. The final ㄱ moves to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 책을 읽다: read a book.

language_specific.morphology: 열- + -세요 → 여세요; stem-final ㄹ drops before -세요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 창문을 열다: open the window.

language_specific.morphology: 듣- + -으세요 → 들으세요; the irregular ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 말을 듣다: listen to what someone says.

language_specific.morphology: 걷- + -으세요 → 걸으세요; the irregular ㄷ changes to ㄹ before a vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이 길로 걷다: walk along this road.

language_specific.morphology: 입- + -으세요 → 입으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 외투를 입다: put on a coat.

language_specific.morphology: 벗- + -으세요 → 벗으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 신발을 벗다: take off shoes.

language_specific.morphology: 씻- + -으세요 → 씻으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 손을 씻다: wash one's hands.

language_specific.morphology: 켜- + -세요 → 켜세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 불을 켜다: turn on the light.

language_specific.morphology: 보- + -세요 → 보세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사진을 보다: look at a photo.

language_specific.morphology: 찾- + -으세요 → 찾으세요; -으세요 follows a consonant-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사전에서 단어를 찾다: look up a word in a dictionary.

language_specific.morphology: 말씀하- + -세요 → 말씀하세요; -세요 follows the vowel-final stem.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely invites the addressee to speak first; 말씀하다 respects the person speaking.

language_specific.morphology: 쉬- + -세요 → 쉬세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
서- + -세요 → 서세요. After a vowel-final stem, -(으)세요 takes the form -세요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker politely instructs the listener to stand in line; -시- also marks respect for the listener.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 줄을 서다: stand in line.

language_specific.morphology: 내려가- + -세요 → 내려가세요; -세요 follows a vowel-final stem.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 계단을 내려가다: go down the stairs.

language_specific.morphology: 오- + -시- + -어요 → 오세요; -시어요 contracts to -세요.
language_specific.social_context: The teacher is the honored subject. The speaker reports this politely to an unspecified listener.

language_specific.morphology: 읽- + -으시- + -어요 → 읽으세요; -으시어요 contracts to -으세요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '읽으세요' [일그세요]. The final ㄱ moves to the following vowel.
language_specific.social_context: Grandmother is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.

language_specific.morphology: 쉬- + -시- + -었어요 → 쉬셨어요; the honorific and past forms contract.
language_specific.social_context: Father is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -시- + -어요 → 가세요; -시어요 contracts to -세요. 내일 places the event in the future.
language_specific.social_context: The teacher is the honored subject; the speaker tells an unspecified listener about the plan.

language_specific.morphology: 살- + -시- + -어요 → 사세요; stem-final ㄹ drops before -시-, and -시어요 contracts to -세요.
language_specific.social_context: Grandfather is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 여기에 살다: live here; 여기 can appear without 에 in speech.

language_specific.morphology: 열- + -시- + -었어요 → 여셨어요; stem-final ㄹ drops before -시-, and the following vowels contract.
language_specific.social_context: Mother is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문을 열다: open the door.

language_specific.morphology: 바쁘- + -시- + -어요 → 바쁘세요; -시어요 contracts to -세요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker asks whether the teacher, the honored subject, is not busy; the listener is addressed politely.

language_specific.morphology: 좋아하- + -시- + -어요 → 좋아하세요; -시어요 contracts to -세요.
language_specific.social_context: Grandmother is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 꽃을 좋아하다: like flowers.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '좋아하세요' [조아하세요]. The ㅎ in 좋 is not pronounced before the following vowel.

language_specific.morphology: 계시- + -어요 → 계세요; 계시다 is the honorific counterpart of 있다 for a person's presence.
language_specific.social_context: The teacher is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 교실에 계시다: be in the classroom.

language_specific.morphology: 주무시- + -어요 → 주무세요; 주무시다 is the honorific counterpart of 자다.
language_specific.social_context: Grandfather is the honored subject; the listener is addressed politely.

language_specific.morphology: 먹- + -어요 → 먹어요; -어요 makes the statement informal polite.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker describes their own habit politely to an unspecified listener; the speaker is not honorified.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 빵을 먹다: eat bread.

language_specific.morphology: 먹- + -습니다 → 먹습니다; -습니다 makes the statement formal polite.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '먹습니다' [먹씀니다]. The consonants change across the ending.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker describes their own habit in a formal polite style; the speaker is not honorified.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 점심을 먹다: eat lunch.

language_specific.morphology: 먹- + -어 → 먹어; -어 is a casual ending.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker tells their mother that they are eating first; the speaker is the subject and beneficiary.

language_specific.morphology: 드시- + -어요 → 드세요; 드시다 is an honorific verb for eating or drinking, and -시어요 contracts to -세요.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker offers fruit to grandmother, who is both the honored eater and the addressee.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 과일을 드시다: eat fruit; the object particle is omitted here.

language_specific.morphology: 드시- + -ㅂ니다 → 드십니다; 드시다 is an honorific verb for eating or drinking.
language_specific.social_context: The speaker formally reports that the teacher is drinking tea. The teacher is the honored subject; the listener is addressed formally and politely.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선생님이 차를 드시다: the teacher drinks tea, with subject honorification.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: '드십니다' [드심니다]. The ㅂ is pronounced ㅁ before ㄴ.

language_specific.morphology: 드시- + -었어요 → 드셨어요; 드시다 is an honorific verb for eating or drinking.
language_specific.social_context: The teacher is the honored subject who drank; the listener is addressed politely.

language_specific.morphology: 오- + -고 → 오고; -고 lists two weather conditions.

language_specific.morphology: 의사 + 이- + -고 → 의사고; the copula 이다 contracts after the vowel-final noun 의사, leaving 고.

language_specific.morphology: 가- + -고 → 가고; -고 links the two clauses, each with a subject marked by 도.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저도 가고 친구도 가다: both I and my friend go.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 양파를 썰다: slice an onion.

language_specific.morphology: 섞- + -고 → 섞고; -고 connects mixing to drinking.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: "섞고" [석꼬]. The final ㄲ is pronounced [ㄱ], and the following ㄱ is tense.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 커피와 우유를 섞다: mix coffee and milk.

language_specific.morphology: 일어나- + -고 → 일어나고; -고 connects waking up to the planned exercise.
먹어서 = 먹- + -어서; -어서 connects the cause to the result.
앉아서 = 앉- + -아서; -아서 connects the cause to the result.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 오래 앉아서 다리가 아파요 [오래 안자서 다리가 아파요]. In 앉아서, ㄴ and ㅈ are pronounced across the syllable boundary.

language_specific.morphology: 춥- changes to 추우- before -어서; 추우어서 contracts to 추워서.
어지럽- + -어서 → 어지러워서: the ㅂ changes to 우 before the vowel-initial ending, forming 워; -어서 gives the reason.
오- + -아서 contracts to 와서.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비가 오다: rain falls.

language_specific.morphology: 열어서 = 열- + -어서; opening the door enables the following action.
사- + -아서 contracts to 사서; the bought milk is then taken home.
가- + -아서 contracts to 가서; going to the bank precedes receiving the money there.
받아서 = 받- + -아서; receiving the ticket precedes entering.
따- + -아서 → 따서: the adjacent 아 vowels contract; -아서 connects picking the fruit to the following activity.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 딸기를 따다: pick strawberries.

language_specific.morphology: 아프- drops ㅡ before -아서, giving 아파서.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 머리가 아프다: have a headache.

language_specific.morphology: 피곤하- + -여서 contracts to 피곤해서.
배고프- drops ㅡ before -아서, giving 배고파서.
조용하- + -여서 contracts to 조용해서.
멀어서 = 멀- + -어서.
빌리- + -어서 contracts to 빌려서.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구에게 책을 빌리다: borrow a book from a friend.

language_specific.morphology: 돌려주- + -어서 contracts to 돌려줘서; returning the book precedes receiving the deposit.

language_specific.morphology: 데우- + -어서 contracts to 데워서.

배우지만 = 배우- + -지만; the second clause qualifies the fact that the speaker is learning Korean.
전화했지만 = 전화하- + -였- + -지만, with 하였 contracted to 했; the call did not get an answer.
language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 전화했지만 친구가 안 받았어요 [전화핻찌만 친구가 안 바다써요]. The following ㅈ is tense after the final consonant of 했.

language_specific.morphology: 학생이지만 = 학생 + 이- + -지만; the copula links the first person to 학생.

language_specific.pronunciation: Sentence: 차가 없지만 버스가 있어요 [차가 업찌만 버스가 이써요]. The cluster in 없 is simplified and the following ㅈ is tense.

language_specific.morphology: 시끄럽지만 = 시끄럽- + -지만; the ㅂ remains before the consonant-initial ending.

language_specific.morphology: 가깝지만 = 가깝- + -지만; the ㅂ remains before the consonant-initial ending.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 가깝지만 [가깝찌만]. The ㅈ is tense after the final ㅂ.

language_specific.morphology: 넓지만 = 넓- + -지만.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 넓지만 [널찌만]. The final consonant cluster is simplified and the following consonant is tense.

language_specific.morphology: 길지만 = 길- + -지만.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 짧지만 [짤찌만]. The final consonant cluster is simplified and the following consonant is tense.

language_specific.morphology: 듣다 → 듣 + 고: ㄷ remains before the consonant-initial connector 고.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 설명을 듣다: listen to an explanation.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 친구들에게 돈을 걷다: collect money from friends.

language_specific.morphology: 받다 → 받 + 아요: the ㄷ stays before 아요 in this regular verb.

language_specific.morphology: 돕다 → 돕 + 고: the stem retains ㅂ before the consonant-initial connector 고.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 돕고 [돕꼬]. The ㄱ in 고 is pronounced as a tense consonant after ㅂ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 동생을 돕다: help a younger sibling.

language_specific.morphology: 덥다 → 더 + 워서: stem-final ㅂ changes to 우 and combines with 어서.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 침대에 눕다: lie down on a bed.

language_specific.morphology: 가볍다 → 가벼 + 우 + 어요 → 가벼워요: stem-final ㅂ changes to 우 before 어요, and 우어 contracts to 워.
어렵다 → 어려 + 웠어요: stem-final ㅂ changes to 우 and combines with 었어요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 손을 잡다: hold a hand.

language_specific.morphology: 덮다 → 덮 + 어요: written ㅍ remains before 어요; unlike ㅂ-irregular stems, it does not change to 우.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이불을 덮다: cover oneself with a blanket.

language_specific.morphology: 입다 → 입 + 었어요: ㅂ remains before 었어요 in this regular verb.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 코트를 입다: put on a coat.

language_specific.morphology: 좁다 → 좁 + 아요: the regular stem retains written ㅂ before 아요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 좁아요 [조바요]. The ㅂ carries over to the following syllable.

language_specific.morphology: 부르다 → 불러 + 요: 르 changes to ㄹ러, with ㄹ added to the preceding syllable.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 노래를 부르다: sing a song.

language_specific.morphology: 부르다 → 불러 + 었어요 → 불렀어요: 르 changes to ㄹ러 before the past ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 택시를 부르다: call a taxi.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 강물이 흐르다: river water flows.

language_specific.morphology: 고르다 → 골라 + 았어요 → 골랐어요: 르 changes to ㄹ라 before the past ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 음식을 고르다: choose food.

language_specific.morphology: 마르다 → 말라 + 요: before 아요, 르 changes to ㄹ라.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 빨래가 마르다: laundry dries.

language_specific.morphology: 따르다 → 따르 + 아요 → 따라요: ㅡ is deleted; no extra ㄹ is added.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 컵에 물을 따르다: pour water into a cup.

language_specific.morphology: 따르다 → 따르 + 았어요 → 따랐어요: ㅡ is deleted; no extra ㄹ is added.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선생님을 따르다: follow a teacher.

language_specific.morphology: 치르다 → 치르 + 었어요 → 치렀어요: ㅡ is deleted; no extra ㄹ is added.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 시험을 치르다: take an exam.

language_specific.morphology: 누르다 → 눌러 + 요: before 어요, 르 changes to ㄹ러.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 버튼을 누르다: press a button.

language_specific.morphology: 빨갛다 → 빨개 + 요: ㅎ is lost and 아 combines with the stem vowel to produce 애.
어떻다 → 어때요: stem-final ㅎ drops before 어요, and the vowels contract to 애.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이 책은 어때요?: ask for an evaluation of this book.

language_specific.morphology: 파랗다 → 파래 + 요: ㅎ is lost and 아 combines with the stem vowel to produce 애.
하얗다 → 하얘 + 요: ㅎ is lost and 아 combines with the stem vowel to produce 얘.
노랗다 → 노래 + 요: ㅎ is lost and 아 combines with the stem vowel to produce 애.

common.sentence: 이 책이 좋아요. 저도 그렇게 생각해요.

language_specific.morphology: 그렇다 → 그렇 + 게 → 그렇게: the written ㅎ remains before 게.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 그렇게 [그러케]. The ㅎ and following ㄱ combine in pronunciation as ㅋ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 그렇게 생각하다: think that way.

language_specific.morphology: 좋다 → 좋 + 아요: written ㅎ remains before 아요 in this regular adjective.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 좋아요 [조아요]. The written ㅎ is not pronounced between vowels.

language_specific.morphology: 많다 → 많 + 을 거예요: the regular stem retains written ㅎ before the vowel-initial future ending 을 거예요.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 많을 거예요 [마늘 꺼예요]. The ㅎ is not pronounced before 을, and 거 is pronounced with a tense consonant.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사람이 많다: there are many people.

language_specific.morphology: 싫다 → 싫 + 어요: written ㅎ remains before 어요 in this regular adjective.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 싫어요 [시러요]. The written ㅎ is not pronounced before 어.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 음식이 싫다: dislike food.

language_specific.morphology: 놓다 → 놓 + 았어요: written ㅎ remains before 았어요 in this regular verb.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 놓았어요 [노아써요]. The written ㅎ is not pronounced between vowels.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 책을 책상에 놓다: put a book on a desk.

language_specific.morphology: 짓다 → 지어요: the irregular stem 짓- drops ㅅ before -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 밥을 짓다: cook rice.

language_specific.morphology: 짓다 → 지었어요: the irregular stem 짓- drops ㅅ before -었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 집을 짓다: build a house.

language_specific.morphology: 낫다 → 나았어요: the irregular stem 낫- drops ㅅ before -았어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 감기가 낫다: a cold gets better.

language_specific.morphology: 붓다 → 부어요: the irregular stem 붓- drops ㅅ before -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 컵에 물을 붓다: pour water into a cup.

language_specific.morphology: 젓다 → 저어요: the irregular stem 젓- drops ㅅ before -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 숟가락으로 국을 젓다: stir soup with a spoon.

language_specific.morphology: 긋다 → 그어요: the irregular stem 긋- drops ㅅ before -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선을 긋다: draw a line.

language_specific.morphology: 잇다 → 이어요: the irregular stem 잇- drops ㅅ before -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 두 마을을 잇다: connect two villages.

language_specific.morphology: 빗다 → 빗어요: the regular stem 빗- retains ㅅ before -어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 머리를 빗다: comb one's hair.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 빗어요 [비서요]. The written ㅅ links to the following vowel.

language_specific.morphology: 웃다 → 웃었어요: the regular stem 웃- retains ㅅ before -었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 이야기에 웃다: laugh at a story.

language_specific.morphology: 씻다 → 씻었어요: the regular stem 씻- retains ㅅ before -었어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 비누로 손을 씻다: wash one's hands with soap.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 씻었어요 [씨서써요]. The written ㅅ links to the following vowel.

language_specific.morphology: 기쁘다 → 기뻐요: stem-final ㅡ drops, and the preceding ㅣ selects -어요.
슬프다 → 슬퍼서: stem-final ㅡ drops, and the preceding ㅡ selects -어서.
나쁘다 → 나빠요: stem-final ㅡ drops, and the preceding ㅏ selects -아요.
잠그다 → 잠가요: stem-final ㅡ drops, and the preceding ㅏ selects -아요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 문을 잠그다: lock the door.

language_specific.morphology: 담그다 → 담갔어요: stem-final ㅡ drops, and the preceding ㅏ selects -았어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 김치를 담그다: prepare kimchi for fermentation.

language_specific.morphology: 다가오다 → 다가와요: stem 다가오- and -아요 contract as 오 + 아 → 와.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 저에게 다가오다: come closer to me.

language_specific.morphology: 버리다 → 버려요: stem 버리- and -어요 contract as 이 + 어 → 여.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 휴지를 쓰레기통에 버리다: throw a tissue in the trash can.

language_specific.morphology: 세우다 → 세워요: stem 세우- and -어요 contract as 우 + 어 → 워.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 자전거를 세우다: stand or park a bicycle.

language_specific.morphology: 내다 → 내요: stem 내- and -어요 coalesce as 애 + 어 → 애.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 선생님께 숙제를 내다: hand homework in to a teacher.

language_specific.morphology: 피우다 → 피워요: stem 피우- and -어요 contract as 우 + 어 → 워.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 꽃을 피우다: bring flowers into bloom.
언니와: with one's older sister, as used by a woman.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker refers respectfully to their parents, with subject honorification in 사세요.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 이모의 아들: one's maternal aunt's son, a cousin.
여섯 시에 일어나다: get up at six.
language_specific.morphology: 일어나다 → 일어나요: stem 일어나- combines with -아요, with 아 + 아 realized as 아.
샤워하다 → 샤워해요: stem 샤워하- and -여요 contract as 하 + 여 → 해.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 강아지를 산책시키다: take a dog for a walk.
language_specific.morphology: 산책시키다 → 산책시켜요: stem 산책시키- combines with -어요, with 이 + 어 contracting to 여.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 날씨를 확인하다: check the weather.
language_specific.morphology: 확인하다 → 확인해요: stem 확인하- combines with -여요, with 하여 contracting to 해.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 가방을 챙기다: get one's bag ready and make sure it is taken.
language_specific.morphology: 챙기다 → 챙겨요: stem 챙기- combines with -어요, with 이 + 어 contracting to 여.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 그릇을 설거지하다: wash the dishes.
language_specific.morphology: 설거지하다 → 설거지해요: stem 설거지하- combines with -여요, with 하여 contracting to 해.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 빨래를 하다: do the laundry.
열쇠를 깜빡하다: forget one's keys absentmindedly.
language_specific.morphology: 깜빡하다 → 깜빡했어요: stem 깜빡하- combines with -였어요, with 하였 contracting to 했.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 토마토를 키우다: grow tomato plants.
language_specific.morphology: 키우다 → 키워요: stem 키우- combines with -어요, with 우 + 어 contracting to 워.
끓이- + -어요 contracts to 끓여요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 물을 끓이다: boil water.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 끓여요 [끄려요]. The ㅎ is not pronounced before the vowel, and ㄹ links to the following syllable.
Target: 삶아요 [살마요]. The final consonants are pronounced across the syllable boundary.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 달걀을 물에 삶다: boil an egg in water.
양파를 팬에 볶다: stir-fry onion in a pan.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 볶아요 [보까요]. The final ㄲ links to the following vowel.

language_specific.morphology: 찌- + -어요 contracts to 쪄요, the informal polite form of 찌다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 감자를 찌다: steam potatoes.

language_specific.morphology: 벗기- + -어요 contracts to 벗겨요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 사과 껍질을 벗기다: peel the skin off an apple.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 벗겨요 [벋껴요]. The final ㅅ is pronounced [ㄷ], and the following ㄱ is tense.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 밥을 그릇에 담다: put rice in a bowl.

language_specific.morphology: 맛 + 을 followed by 보- + -아요, contracted to 봐요; the dictionary phrase is 맛을 보다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 국 맛을 보다: taste the soup.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 숟가락 [숟까락]. The ㄱ is pronounced tense after the final ㄷ.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 반찬으로 먹다: eat something as a side dish.

common.meaning: skip a meal; go without eating

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 굶어요 [굴머요]. The final consonants are distributed across the syllables before the vowel ending.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 아침을 굶다: skip breakfast.
환불을 받다: receive a refund.
신발의 사이즈가 크다: shoes are large in size.

language_specific.morphology: 다른 is an independent determiner meaning “another” or “different”; it precedes 색.
language_specific.social_context: A customer asks a shop worker about a shirt.

language_specific.morphology: 계산하- + -였어요 contracts to 계산했어요, the past informal polite form of 계산하다.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 카드로 계산하다: pay by card.

language_specific.social_context: A customer asks a worker to put purchases in a bag.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 봉투에 물건을 넣다: put items in a bag.

language_specific.social_context: An ordinary polite statement about payment in cash.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 현금으로 내다: pay in cash.

language_specific.social_context: A worker hands change to a customer.

language_specific.lexical_frame: 할인을 하다: offer a discount.

language_specific.social_context: The speaker states that they are exchanging this item of clothing.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 옷을 교환하다: exchange an item of clothing.
language_specific.morphology: 교환하- + -여요 contracts to 교환해요.
닫히- + -었어요 contracts to 닫혔어요, the past polite form of 닫히다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 닫혔어요 [다쳐써요]. ㄷ and ㅎ combine, and the resulting sound is palatalized before ㅕ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 가게 문이 닫히다: a shop's door closes.
정류장에서 내리다: get off at a stop.
지하철로 갈아타다: transfer to the subway.
학교 앞을 지나가다: pass in front of a school.
역 근처에: near the station.
출구로 나가다: go out through an exit.

language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 맞은편 [마즌편]. The final ㅈ links to the following vowel.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 은행 맞은편에 있다: be opposite the bank.
골목으로 들어가다: enter an alley.
집에 돌아가다: go back home.

language_specific.morphology: 막히- + -었어요 contracts to 막혔어요, the past polite form of 막히다.
language_specific.pronunciation: Target: 막혔어요 [마켜써요]. The ㄱ and ㅎ combine as aspirated ㅋ.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 차가 길에서 막히다: a vehicle gets stuck in traffic.
역 방향으로 가다: go in the direction of the station.

language_specific.morphology: 정하- + -여요 contracts to 정해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 회의 시간을 정하다: set the time of a meeting.
회의가 세 시로 바뀌다: a meeting is changed to three o'clock.

language_specific.morphology: 미루- + -었어요 contracts to 미뤘어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 소풍을 미루다: postpone a picnic.

language_specific.morphology: 취소되- + -었어요 contracts to 취소됐어요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 수업이 취소되다: a class is canceled.

language_specific.morphology: 신청하- + -여요 contracts to 신청해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 금요일에 신청하다: apply on Friday.
시간이 비다: have an unoccupied time slot.
약속에 늦다: be late for an appointment.

language_specific.morphology: 표시하- + -여요 contracts to 표시해요.
language_specific.lexical_frame: 날짜를 달력에 표시하다: mark a date on a calendar.
일정이 바쁘다: have a busy schedule.
매주 화요일: every Tuesday.
